summary: Iteration 67 - Full backend + frontend verification of the new Estate Intelligence report (v2) and read-only M9 training endpoints. 16/16 pytest tests pass. Frontend /os/admin/estate/intelligence renders every specified data-testid (surface, title, lead, meta with census eij-1b359b3cbd2e, 10 tiles matching all target values, condition bar, 20-row databases table with viusasa_staging row, sort chips rows/bytes/grade that reorder the table, duplication section with both tables, quality section incl. degradation-kinds/dead-columns/trend showing previous job eij-91933223a5b1/orphans/top-degraded/top-pii, 8 product cards with reference_data grain expanded and toggles that expand/collapse others, 7 strategies with evidence+Risk on toggle, dossier meta showing gpt-5-mini with dossier text rendered as HTML (no raw ** markers), method+errors section mentioning artists_app, reload button, download-brief with correct href /briefs/Akki_Estate_Intelligence_eij-1b359b3cbd2e.md, back-registry link, and compose-dossier button visible for the operator (NOT clicked to avoid the real LLM call)). Registry drawer at /os/admin/estate?app=registry opens 'What your data can do' via the intelligence opportunity card and now contains 'Open the full report' + 'Download the brief' actions; clicking 'Open the full report' navigates to /os/admin/estate/intelligence. Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow (documentElement.scrollWidth == 390), all 10 tiles stack to a single column at 316px, all three tables (databases, duplicate-pairs, within-duplicates) are wrapped in scroll containers. Backend tenant scoping and RBAC all verified: DIGICOW operator gets report:null and jobs:[]; anonymous 401; analyst 403 on compose; unknown job ids 404; invalid phase POST returns 422.
critical_code_review_comments: Report contract note: /api/training/m9/jobs/<id> exposes run_certificate.per_stratum at the certificate root while moac holds only m_a_improvement / m_b / m_e / floors_class / card. The review request text put per_stratum inside moac; the actual (and reasonable) shape is per_stratum alongside moac. Consider adding per_stratum key to the moac object too (or updating the doc) so the contract matches the phrasing.
